name: Jingjin Yu
title: Associate Professor; Interim Graduate Program Director
fitReason: Strong robot-perception/physical-AI fit through foundation-model depth estimation for actual grasping, alongside algorithmic planning. Best suited to a bounded perception-to-manipulation or planning/perception integration project rather than social HRI.

physicalEvidence.summary: IROS 2025 MOMA uses a Depth Anything model (including LoRA fine-tuning for transparent objects), one-shot metric alignment, and a physical UR5e with Robotiq two-finger or vacuum grippers. After one RGB-D calibration scene, the depth sensor is disabled for the monocular-model method; experiments cover opaque/transparent tabletop and bin picks. September 24, 2026 ST-pRRTC separately demonstrates a physical UR5e among two, three and five moving Crazyflies. That latter method is GPU-parallel classical planning with prescribed obstacle trajectories and synchronized preplanned execution, not a learned policy or online replanning.

shortVisit.summary: Live ARC-L homepage invites motivated prospective undergraduate and graduate researchers, explicitly including summer volunteers, by email with resume/transcripts and research interests. No summer2027 capacity, eight-week duration, overseas-master’s appointment or stipend is promised.

scoreReasons.fit: 37/40: substantive learned robot perception and physical manipulation; broader work is classical planning rather than primarily HRI/VLA.
scoreReasons.physical: 25/25: directly documented current-host physical grasping and 2026 arm/drone demonstrations.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: 8/20: explicit summer volunteer inquiry including graduates, but duration/international eligibility/funding approval are unresolved.
scoreReasons.freshness: 15/15: substantive September 2026 physical primary paper, with clearly separated 2025 learning evidence.

Rutgers live broad J-1 guidance caps personal funds at 25%, while the separate Student Intern instructions name personal/family funding without explicitly resolving that cap. Fully personal funding is therefore not verified acceptable.

The central Student Intern category covers currently overseas-enrolled graduate students and 3-week–12-month visits, requiring home-degree contribution and return; actual faculty admission and formal host process remain necessary.
Public funding/fee amounts and internship work-hour wording require category-specific confirmation; do not treat ordinary volunteering as an informal tourist-visa route.
